marketing.howItWorksDesc: Three steps from problem to professional report.
marketing.step1Desc: Start a new 8D report with guided prompts. Describe the problem, attach photos, and define your team — all in a structured workflow.
marketing.step2Desc: Work through D0 to D8 with built-in tools for root cause analysis, containment actions, and corrective measures. Collaborate with your team in real time.
marketing.step3Desc: Generate a professional PDF report with one click. Share it with customers, auditors, or your quality management system — always audit-ready.
marketing.pricingDesc: Start for free. Upgrade when you need more.
marketing.proDesc: Unlimited personal reports for quality professionals.
marketing.testimonial: We used to spend 40 minutes formatting an 8D report in Excel for every customer complaint. With 8D Reports, we just fill in the steps and hit export. It has changed how our quality team works.
marketing.testimonialRole: Senior Quality Engineer, Automotive Tier 1 Supplier
marketing.faqDesc: Everything you need to know about 8D Reports.
marketing.faq1A: 8D (Eight Disciplines) is a structured problem-solving methodology used in manufacturing and engineering to identify, correct, and eliminate recurring problems. It covers everything from team formation (D1) to congratulating the team (D8).
marketing.faq2Q: Is this just another spreadsheet template?
marketing.faq2A: No. 8D Reports is a focused SaaS application with structured D0-D8 workflows, attachments, sharing, and one-click PDF/Word exports. Team governance features such as approval, locking, revisions, and Activity Log are part of the Team plan.
marketing.faq3A: Yes. Both Free and Pro plans include one-click PDF export with professional formatting suitable for customer submissions and quality audits.
marketing.faq4A: All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We use Neon serverless Postgres and Cloudflare R2 for secure, scalable storage. You own your data — export it anytime.
marketing.faq5Q: What happens when I hit the 3-report limit?
marketing.faq5A: On the Free plan, you can create up to 3 reports lifetime. After that, upgrade to Pro for unlimited personal reports or Team for a shared workspace. Your existing reports remain accessible and exportable.
marketing.faq6Q: Do you support teams with multiple users?
marketing.faq6A: Yes. The Team plan includes 5 seats and a shared team report workspace. The owner can add registered users from the dashboard.
marketing.ctaBottom: Ready to replace your Excel template?
marketing.ctaBottomDesc: Start creating professional 8D reports in minutes. No credit card required.

docs.title: 8D Reports — Product Work Instruction (WI)
docs.lastUpdated: For all users · Last updated May 2026

section1.title: 1. Product Overview
section1.intro: 8D Reports is a cloud-based 8D (Eight Disciplines) problem-solving report platform for manufacturing quality engineers, supplier quality managers, and system auditors. It replaces scattered notes and Excel templates with structured D0–D8 workflows, evidence uploads, PDF delivery, Pro Word export, and reusable quality knowledge.
section1.scenario3: Recurring defect review using historical 8D report search
section1.requirements: Supports all modern browsers (Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox). Chrome latest version is recommended for best experience. Mobile browser supports basic operations; camera upload requires a device with camera.

section2.title: 2. Quick Start
section2.signupStep2: Enter name, email, and password (password requires 8+ characters with uppercase, lowercase, digit, and special character)
section2.signupStep3: Click Create account to complete registration
section2.signupStep4: System generates a verification code (displayed in server logs in current version); enter it to complete email verification
section2.signupStep5: After verification, automatically redirect to Dashboard
section2.createStep1: After login, go to Dashboard and click New Report button
section2.createStep2: Choose report type: Customer 8D or Internal 8D
section2.createStep4: Click Start Report; system auto-generates report number (format: YYYY-MM-DD-sequence)
section2.typeCustomerDesc: Formal customer complaint, requires submitting 8D report to customer
section2.typeCustomerFlow: D0 Prepare → D1 Team → D2 Describe → D3 Contain → D4 Root Cause → D5 Correct → D6 Implement → D7 Prevent → D8 Close
section2.typeInternalDesc: Internally discovered quality anomaly, internal improvement

section3.title: 3. Report Editing
section3.navDesc: Report editor shows D0 to D8 navigation on the left (desktop) or top (mobile). Click any step to switch editing area. Completed steps show a checkmark. Bottom provides Previous and Next buttons for step-by-step guidance.
section3.attachmentDesc: In D2, D3, D5, D6, D7 steps, upload attachments in three ways:
section3.photoBtn: Take Photo: Click to use device camera directly
section3.libraryBtn: Photo Library: Select images from device gallery
section3.fileBtn: Upload File: Upload PDF, Excel, Word, CSV documents
section3.attachmentLimit: Limit: Single file max 5MB, max 10 attachments per report. Supported formats: JPG, PNG, WebP, PDF, XLSX, DOCX, CSV, TXT, ZIP.
section3.previewDesc: Uploaded images show thumbnails; click to enlarge preview. Non-image files open in new tab.
section3.saveDesc: Click Save button or use shortcut to save current step. System retains all entered data. Report status shown in top badge: Draft / In Progress / Completed.

section4.title: 4. Export & Share
section4.exportIntro: On report editor top bar, click Export button and choose format:
section4.pdfDesc: Generate A4 professional layout PDF with cover, step content, attachment images, and page numbers
section4.wordDesc: Pro only: generate .docx format documents for further editing
section4.attachment: With Attachments: Export with attachments auto-packaged as ZIP file with report document and attachments folder
section4.watermarkNote: Free plan exports have SAMPLE watermark; Pro plan exports have no watermark.
section4.shareStep1: Click Share button on report editor
section4.shareStep2: Choose permission: View only or Can edit
section4.shareStep3: Click to generate share link; copy and send to collaborators
section4.shareStep4: In Can edit mode, collaborators can edit report content online
section4.shareStep5: Can delete share link anytime to revoke access

section5.title: 5. AI Report Drafting (Coming Soon)
section5.intro: AI drafting is not part of the current production workflow yet. The editor includes a lightweight interest entry so we can validate demand before building full D0–D8 draft generation. The future direction is:
section5.item1: Provide customer emails, inspection records, photos, containment notes, and 5-Why drafts
section5.item2: Generate a structured D0–D8 draft for user review
section5.item3: Keep the quality engineer responsible for approval and evidence
section5.item4: Use Pro or usage-based AI limits when the feature launches
section5.item5: Avoid automatic approval or unsupported claims

section6.title: 6. Account & Quota
section6.upgradeLink: Go to pricing to choose Pro at $19/month, Team at $99/month, or one-time report export at $4.99/report.

section7.title: 7. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
section7.q1Q: Q: Can I edit the report number?
section7.q1A: A: Yes. Report number is auto-generated in D0 (format YYYY-MM-DD-sequence) but can be edited anytime.
section7.q2Q: Q: What language is the public website available in?
section7.q2A: A: The public website is currently presented in English for product review and international customers. In-app localization can be expanded later.
section7.q3Q: Q: Do uploaded images appear in exported files?
section7.q3A: A: Yes. When exporting PDF and Word, images uploaded to each step appear at the corresponding position. All attachment files are packaged in the ZIP file's attachments folder.
section7.q4Q: Q: Can I set a password for share links?
section7.q4A: A: Current version shares via unique token links. Links can be deleted anytime to revoke access. Password protection is not included in the current version.
section7.q5Q: Q: How is my data secured?
section7.q5A: A: Data uses encrypted transmission (HTTPS) and encrypted storage. Database uses Neon Serverless Postgres, files stored on Cloudflare R2. You can export all your data anytime.

D3.fields: Containment measures, Responsible person, Due date, Attachments

D4.name: D4: Root Cause
D4.fields: Root cause occurrence/escape/system, Fishbone 6M analysis, 5-Why analysis, testing evidence

D5.name: D5: Correct
D5.fields: Corrective actions, Responsible person, Due date, Attachments

D7.name: D7: Prevent
D7.fields: Prevention measures, Standard document updates, Attachments

D8.name: D8: Close
D8.fields: Team acknowledgment, Management sign-off, Close date
